Licence_Funnel.Definition: Paid but unused seats, by team: paid and assigned, with no qualifying use in the warehouse. Compares vendor entitlement (what NimbusPay pays for), identity assignment (who is assigned access) and qualifying usage (who actually uses it). SSO or SCIM shows who has an account; it does not prove what the vendor bills for.
Licence_Funnel.Test: Reconciles by team; unmatched records listed
Licence_Funnel.Label: Working definition, to agree
